list: the official 55 trophies, 2026-11-18 (names and descriptions as PlayStation publishes them)
note: Guides are written in the author's own words for this entry. Names and descriptions are the official ones; every guide cites its sources. Counts (stunts, vehicles, spots) are as the trophy tracker and PowerPyx report them at launch.

trophies.guide: This is the platinum, so it pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. There is nothing extra to do for it — just finish the roadmap, stage by stage, and it unlocks with the last trophy you earn. Keep the tracker in this app ticked as you go so you can see exactly what is left.

trophies.guide: This gold trophy is for the in-game 100% Completion Checklist, which appears under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion after the credits — and it is far more forgiving than it sounds, closer to 60%. You need any 100 optional missions, any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, any 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 stunts and any 70 of 80 challenges. Only the robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need everything, so focus on those while letting the forgiving categories fill up on their own.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Stunts are the short driving and riding challenges scattered around Leonida, and there are 397 of them in total — you only need 250. They also feed the 100% checklist, which needs 300, so keep doing them past this trophy. Pick stunts near where you already are, and use a fast, stable vehicle so you can retry quickly when one fails.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Leonida has 9 types of activity, and this trophy just asks you to try each one once — no winning or high score needed. Work through them one by one in free-roam: a race, a shooting range, a fishing spot, an arcade game and the rest. It is a sampler trophy, so it is best done in Stage 5 when you are mopping up.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 42 shooting range challenges, and this one demands a gold medal in every single one — the strictest of the checklist categories. Take them one range at a time, learn each weapon's recoil and the target layout, and retry a challenge until the gold threshold is met. It is slow but straightforward, and it also ticks off the shooting range part of the 100% checklist.

Drone races also count toward the 100% checklist, where all of them are required, so this trophy and the checklist move together. Learn each course's turns before pushing for speed, and use the drone's boost on the long straights.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: This is the ONLY missable trophy in the game, so read it carefully. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations in Leonida, and both Lucia and Jason can meditate at each spot, which counts as +2 at the same location. Track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. The Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house disappears after Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks out to the balcony, and you follow her and choose Accept. That meditation adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a spot like the rest, and it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy; PowerPyx's author did it and then earned the trophy, so doing it is the safe move. The final meditation needs both characters together, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Note that for the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 meditations are needed, so the trophy is stricter than the checklist here.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

Cards turn up in shops, hidden spots and mission rewards, so pick up every card you see and check which sets are closest to complete. Focus on the sets where you already hold most cards instead of starting new ones.

You will already have scanned plenty of vehicles and spots during the story, so keep using WAiNK on anything new you pass. Challenges cover driving, shooting, flying and more, so pick the ones that suit your strengths and clear them in batches. Check the challenge list often to see which are closest to done.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: You need a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then you have to lose the police and escape. Build the wanted level away from tight streets — open roads and water give you room to break line of sight — then drive hard, switch vehicles if you can, and hide until the stars clear. Do it with your partner beside you, or it does not count.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, and keep your wanted level the whole way through — losing it breaks the chain. Plan a route with 3 shops close together, hit them quickly one after another, and keep moving so the police stay on you but cannot catch you. A fast getaway car parked nearby helps a lot.

Find a spot with a cluster of enemies, trigger Combat Focus when they are grouped, and work through them quickly before it ends. A weapon with a fast fire rate and good accuracy makes the window much easier.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: A jewelry store robbery usually ends in a shootout, but this trophy demands a clean one: get in, take the goods, and get out without being detected. Plan your entry, move quietly, watch the staff and cameras, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, back out and try again.

Vault robberies are among the bigger paydays in the game — up to $205,000 each — so they also fund the money trophies. Plan each vault, bring the right tools, and have a getaway route ready before you go in.

Drive, fly and sail through every corner of the state — the beaches, the swamps, the Keys and the back roads — until no grey fog is left. It pairs naturally with the vehicle and WAiNK scanning, so do it all in the same sweeps.

Keep going until all 52 areas are unfogged.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs run illegal operations around Leonida, and you need to rob one operation belonging to each of them. Find an operation, hit it, and move on to the next gang's turf. These robberies also count toward the 100% checklist, where all of them are required.
trophies.name: Pest Control

steps: Find an illegal operation on gang turf.
Rob it.
Repeat for all 9 gangs.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: This is a quiet one: go to Ocean Beach, find a spot with a view, and enjoy a cocktail there. No combat, no chase — just sit, order a drink, and let the trophy pop. It is a nice breather between the louder Stage 5 jobs.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (list cross-checked with Exophase and PSNProfiles)

steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Find a bar spot with a view.
Order and enjoy a cocktail.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: This trophy is a nod to the series' classic moments: drive a vehicle straight out through the glass of a showroom. Pick a showroom, get a car inside or lined up at the window, and smash your way out. It pops as soon as you break through.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (list cross-checked with Exophase and PSNProfiles)
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Go to a vehicle showroom.
Get a car lined up at the glass.
Drive out through the showroom front.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The Kolt & Associates bowling alley hides a small job: follow through there and collect the 3 valuables tied to it. Head to the alley, look around for what is out of place, and take the valuables. It is a short, cryptic trophy, so check the spot carefully rather than rushing past.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (list cross-checked with Exophase and PSNProfiles)
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Look for the 3 valuables there.
Collect all 3.

trophies.guide: This trophy is about reaching maximum strength with both characters — a partnership with mass appeal, in both senses. Train each character's strength up to the top, through gym work and physical activity, and the trophy pops when both are maxed. It is a slow grind, so start it early and keep at it between missions.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (list cross-checked with Exophase and PSNProfiles)

steps: Train one character's strength to maximum.
Switch characters and do the same.
The trophy pops when both are maxed.

trophies.guide: The criminal profile tracks your choices — for better or worse — and this trophy needs 500 actions on it. It builds up naturally across a full playthrough: robberies, crimes, and the many small decisions that add to the profile. Just keep playing the way the game encourages and check the profile counter now and then to see how close you are.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Play through missions and side content.
Keep adding criminal-profile actions.
Reach 500 actions on the profile.

trophies.guide: This is the Payday Loans second chance: if a plan goes wrong the first time, the second attempt is the charm. Take a Payday Loan, and when the first try at the linked job fails or falls short, go back and do it again — the trophy is for the second time working out. It is one of the cryptic Stage 5 trophies, so do not worry if it does not pop on the first attempt.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Take a Payday Loan.
Attempt the linked job.
Try a second time — the second attempt is the charm.

trophies.guide: This is the UFO easter egg trophy, and the description says it all: what the hell just happened? Something strange is out there in Leonida at night, and finding it — and sticking around to see it through — earns this trophy. Head to the right place after dark, keep your eyes on the sky, and let the encounter play out.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

steps: Go out at night to the UFO sighting spot.
Watch the sky for the strange lights.
Stay until the encounter finishes.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: You need to bowl over 10 people with a melee drive-by within 60 seconds — a drive-by where the weapon is melee, not a gun. Find a crowded stretch, drive slowly past a group, and swing as you pass. Line up a busy pavement so you can chain the hits inside the minute.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Find a crowded pavement.
Start a melee drive-by from a slow vehicle.
Bowl over 10 people within 60 seconds.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked bills come from robberies, and they are no good until laundered through a fence contact. Hand over the marked bills, take the clean cut, and keep going until $250,000 has been laundered. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each, so a few vaults fund this trophy on their own.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

Take them to a fence contact.
Launder $250,000 in total.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all the shops in Leonida — clothes, weapons, vehicles, food, anything that takes money. It adds up fast once you are buying gear for the vault and robbery trophies, so just spend normally and check the counter. If you are short at the end, buy a big-ticket item you actually want.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

Keep spending across different shops.
Reach $100,000 spent in total.

trophies.guide: There are 8 purchasable garages in Leonida, bought through the Vice City Real Estate app for $160,000 in total. Open the app, buy each garage in turn, and the trophy pops with the last one. The vault money covers the cost easily once the vaults are open.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

Buy a garage.
Repeat until all 8 garages are owned.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Scooter Bros is the app for registering vehicles, and this trophy needs 10 of them registered. Find vehicles you own or pick up, open the app, and register each one. It is quick once you have a few cars in your garages, so do it right after buying the garages for Little Boxes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
